env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOAMD64=v1

cd m
logos eject -o out
exists out/go.mod
! grep -ri 'archsimd' out
logos build -o $WORK/portable$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/portable$GOEXE
stdout '^ok portable-bytes$'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/jsonportable

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

type Item struct {
	S string  `json:"s"`
	F float64 `json:"f"`
	I int64   `json:"i"`
}

type Mirror struct {
	S     string  `json:"s"`
	F     float64 `json:"f"`
	I     int64   `json:"i"`
	NoGen any     `json:"-"`
}

func main() {
	strs := []string{"", "plain", "<script>alert(1)&</script>", "line\u2028sep\u2029end", "tab\tnl\nret\rbs", "\"quoted\"", "é世界"}
	floats := []float64{0, 1.5, -2.25, 1e21, 1e-7, 1e-6, 123456789.0, 5e-324}
	for _, s := range strs {
		for _, f := range floats {
			v := Item{S: s, F: f, I: -3}
			got, gerr := v.MarshalJSON()
			want, werr := json.Marshal(Mirror{S: s, F: f, I: -3})
			if (gerr == nil) != (werr == nil) {
				fmt.Printf("FAIL error mismatch for %q %v: %v vs %v\n", s, f, gerr, werr)
				os.Exit(1)
			}
			if gerr != nil {
				continue
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
				fmt.Printf("FAIL bytes differ for %q %v:\n got %s\nwant %s\n", s, f, got, want)
				os.Exit(1)
			}
			if !json.Valid(got) {
				fmt.Printf("FAIL invalid JSON for %q %v: %s\n", s, f, got)
				os.Exit(1)
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("ok portable-bytes")
}
